O.content: The top of the Safari bar is higher on the page than the top of the Chrome bar.
The printed vertical-axis ticks run from "0" at the baseline upward through "10" to "100".

B.text: If bar height against the vertical axis is the authoritative usage-share encoding, with higher bar tops indicating greater share, and the primary target is the selectable browser with the greatest share, select the browser with the highest bar among the selectable products.
B.conditions: Applies only if the plotted bar geometry is authoritative despite the percentage inscriptions that conflict with it.

O.content: The title reads "Browser Usage Share by Product".
The inscription "73%" is printed above the bar labeled "Chrome".
The inscription "12%" is printed above the bar labeled "Safari".
The inscription "6%" is printed above the bar labeled "Firefox".

B.text: If the percentage inscriptions above product bars are the authoritative browser usage-share values, and primary compatibility targeting is assigned to the selectable browser with the greatest shown usage share, select that browser.
B.conditions: Applies only if each printed percentage belongs to the bar directly below it and printed labels, rather than conflicting bar heights, encode the intended shares.
